name: Sing Bhujiya- Hot peanuts
ingredients_raw: Peanuts (60%), Edible Vegetabie Oil (Palmolein Oil), Split Chickpea Flour, Black Gram FlOur, Maize Starch, lodised Satt Red Chill Powder, Black Pepper, Dried Mango Powder, Spice Blend, Carom Seeds.
